label: Stuck pipe
engineering_rationale: Sticking is the product of a rock/pressure mismatch and a contact mechanics mismatch, so formation match and TVD window lead; the mud programme enters because differential sticking needs an overbalance margin that is a mud-weight decision; the hole section and bit enter because pack-off and wellbore damage are section-specific. Nearby offsets are weighted more than for mud loss because the same differential-pressure trap affects a neighbourhood, not a single well.
references: Saaty, T.L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process. McGraw-Hill, New York.
